settings.heading: Authenticity first
settings.text: Every crest is embroidered, not printed, and every design is checked against the real thing before it goes into production.

settings.heading: Built to last
settings.text: Heavyweight vintage-style fabric that's meant to survive seasons of wear, not just one wash.

settings.heading: Shipped with care
settings.text: Every order is packed like it's going to a friend, because more often than not, it is.

settings.heading: Run by fans
settings.text: We're customers first. If we wouldn't wear it ourselves on race day, we don't sell it.
Overtake is founded by two best friends who couldn't find vintage-style racing jackets that actually felt authentic, so they started making them.
The first batch of jackets ships out to early customers, sourced and packed by hand from a spare bedroom.
Word spreads across the F1 community. Overtake crosses its first major order milestone and the lineup grows past the original teams.
Now shipping across Europe and beyond, with new drops, new teams, and vintage designs added every season.

settings.caption: [PLACEHOLDER — the two of you, day one]

settings.hero_heading: Started between two best friends. Built for the grid.
settings.hero_subheading: Overtake began in 2024 with one simple idea: vintage racing jackets that actually feel authentic. Here's how it happened.
settings.story_text:
We started Overtake in 2024, the two of us, out of a shared obsession with F1 and the golden era of racewear. We kept looking for jackets that captured that vintage pit-lane feel and kept coming up empty, so we decided to make them ourselves.

What began as a handful of sample jackets shipped to friends has turned into thousands of orders across Europe and beyond. Same two founders, same obsession with getting every stitch, every crest, and every fit exactly right — just a lot more jackets out the door.
